description: This file defines an abstract base class for Drupal Views exposed filter form plugins, including methods for building forms, rendering, querying, resetting, and cache management.

classes.name: ExposedFormPluginBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for Views exposed filter form plugins, providing common functionality such as form building, rendering, query modification, and cache handling.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the exposed form, such as button labels and sorting labels.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the exposed filter options.

methods.name: renderExposedForm
methods.description: Renders the exposed filter form, handling AJAX and display conditions.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Modifies the view query based on exposed filter inputs.

methods.name: exposedFormAlter
methods.description: Alters the exposed form, adding sort and reset controls, and integrating with pagination.

methods.name: exposedFormValidate
methods.description: Validates the exposed form, including pagination.

methods.name: exposedFormSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, including reset and pagination.

methods.name: resetForm
methods.description: Resets all exposed filter states and session data.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Returns cache max age, set to permanent.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts based on exposed sort order and filters.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags, empty in this implementation.
